stem: A suspected equipment fault would require opening a guarded electrical panel beyond the technician’s authorization. What is the correct boundary?
choices: Open the panel if the technician is confident.
Stop at authorized checks and hand the suspected fault to the qualified maintenance role.
Bypass the guard temporarily to confirm the fault.
Change unrelated setpoints so the alarm stops.
rationale: Diagnostic competence does not create maintenance authorization; safe troubleshooting ends where the assigned repair boundary begins.
